summary: Practise IAS 16 recognition, depreciation, impairment and disclosure workflows. Review asset schedules and build a practical close checklist.
lede: IAS 16 sets out how to account for property, plant and equipment, from recognition through disposal. For financial and fixed-asset accountants, reporting analysts and finance managers, applying it means building traceable asset records and supporting close decisions. Training covers assessing initial costs and components, calculating depreciation, reviewing estimates and impairment indicators, and preparing register reconciliations and disclosure schedules.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, review or control property, plant and equipment accounting records and related financial reporting.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of financial accounting and preparation or review of financial statements is expected. Familiarity with fixed-asset records is useful. Coding or programming is not required.
